result.summary: Several visual/layout issues are present: truncated restaurant names, a cut-off category pill, overlapping/crowded time badges on cards, and incomplete bottom content that suggests clipping.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing characters at the end of the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size on smaller cards, or ensure horizontal scroll/card width accommodates full names without ellipsis cut-off mid-word.

issues.description: The category filter row is cut off on the right; a partial pill is visible after 'Healthy', indicating overflow without clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll is obvious (fade/gradient or peek of next item) or wrap/resize chips so all primary categories are fully visible.

issues.description: Delivery time badges (e.g. '15–25 min', '20–30 min') sit tightly on food images and can feel overlaid/crowded against the artwork.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent padding/margin and stronger contrast or shadow so badges remain legible and don’t collide with key parts of the illustration.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is partially clipped by the viewport/tab bar, so the offer and restaurant details below the image are not fully shown.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar and ensure cards aren’t cut mid-image when scrolling stops.

issues.description: Heart/favorite icons on dark food images have low visual separation and may be hard to notice.
issues.suggestion: Use a higher-contrast icon treatment (filled circle background or stronger stroke) for better visibility.
